title.zh: 核聚变为什么总是“还要三十年”
title.en: Why Fusion Is Always “Thirty Years Away”

desc.zh: 从原子质量、库仑势垒、隧穿和劳森判据，一路走到托卡马克、惯性约束、氚与中子，再到截至 2026 年的实验记录和 1976 年的经费规划：聚变为什么这么难，又为什么总是“还要三十年”。
desc.en: From atomic masses, the Coulomb barrier, tunnelling and the Lawson criterion, through tokamaks, inertial confinement, tritium and neutrons, to the experimental record as of 2026 and the 1976 funding plans: why fusion is so hard, and why it is always “thirty years away”.
